newsitem.title: UK: NWE gas oil differentials steady, trade thin.
newsitem.headline: NWE gas oil differentials steady, trade thin.

text.p: European gas oil differentials were unchanged to slightly softer in sluggish discussion on Friday, traders said.
August IPE was 25 cents off at $165 a tonne in very slow trade.

On the key ARA barge market, sellers again struggled to find signs of demand. Buyers have been deterred for most of the past week by stubborn dollar strength against the mark that has made oil product imports prohibitively expensive into Germany.

Rotterdam refinery heating oil was offered unchanged at August IPE +50 cents. Storage quality heating oil and refinery grade basis Flushing and Antwerp were offered slightly softer at around screen flat to August IPE -25 cents.
Low sulphur diesel was offered at a premium of around $5 and was bid at $4 above the August contract.
NWE cargo discussion was slow with little discussion.
In the Med, Turkey bought 75,000 tonnes of 0.7 and 0.2 percent gas oil for delivery in late July and second decade August at premiums of $7.99 and $10.88 above fob Med mean quotes, traders said.
